summary: community.sops deprecated support for EOL Ansible versions; its next major release drops Ansible 2.9, ansible-base 2.10 and ansible-core 2.11 through 2.14.
questions: Will community.sops work with ansible-core 2.13 after its next major version?
Which Ansible versions is community.sops dropping?

answer_card.title: community.sops drops EOL Ansible versions
answer_card.answer_md: The next major **community.sops** release drops **Ansible 2.9, ansible-base 2.10 and ansible-core 2.11 to 2.14**. Upgrade ansible-core before moving to it.
